QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_43

question.text: Reports that a Cat III AIF must submit to SEBI on a QUARTERLY basis include:

answer.text: Activity report (T+10) AND a separate leverage report (T+10)

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 13.2.4: All AIFs file a quarterly activity report within 10 calendar days of quarter-end; ADDITIONALLY, all Cat III AIFs file a separate quarterly leverage report in pre-defined format. Both are on T+10 and go via the SEBI Intermediary Portal. The Trap: Audited financials (A) are annual, not quarterly. Investor demographics (C) and PPM changes (D) are not the quarterly SEBI reports. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests both quarterly reports. XIX-D (Cat I/II) does NOT require a leverage report (no leverage permitted for Cat I/II). Manager's Pro-Tip: The leverage report is the Cat III-specific Filling — report gross and net exposure, borrowed cash notional, derivative notional, main source of leverage, margin utilisation. Reconcile with the prime-broker and ISDA custodian MTM statements.
